import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

np.random.seed(0)
ALPHA = 0.05

raw = pd.read_csv("/analysis-001/data/inputs/f-counts/counts.tsv", sep="\t", index_col=0)

raw_res = stats.results_df.copy()
stats.lfc_shrink(coeff="group[T.treated]")
res = stats.results_df.copy()

out = pd.DataFrame({"gene": res.index, "symbol": symbols.reindex(res.index).values,

import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg")

np.random.seed(0)
for d in ("output", "figures", "logs"):
    __import__("os").makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
raw = pd.read_csv("/analysis-001/data/inputs/f-counts/counts.tsv", sep="\t")

meta["batch"] = meta["batch"].astype(str)
samples = list(meta.index)
ann = raw[["gene_id", "symbol"]].set_index("gene_id")
counts = raw.set_index("gene_id")[samples].T.astype(int)
print("library sizes:\n", counts.sum(1))

# filter: >=10 counts in >= 3 samples (smallest group size)
keep = (counts >= 10).sum(0) >= 3
print("genes kept", keep.sum(), "of", len(keep))
counts = counts.loc[:, keep]

# PCA QC (top 500 variable genes, log1p of depth-scaled counts)
lg = np.log2(counts.div(counts.sum(1), axis=0) * counts.sum(1).mean() + 1)
top = lg.var(0).nlargest(500).index
X = lg[top] - lg[top].mean()
U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(X.values, full_matrices=False)
pcs = U * S
ve = S**2 / (S**2).sum()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 4))
cols = {"treated": "#E69F00", "control": "#0072B2"}
mk = {"1": "o", "2": "s"}
for i, s in enumerate(samples):
    ax.scatter(pcs[i, 0], pcs[i, 1], c=cols[meta.group[s]], marker=mk[meta.batch[s]], s=80)
    ax.annotate(s, (pcs[i, 0], pcs[i, 1]), xytext=(4, 4), textcoords="offset points")
ax.set_xlabel(f"PC1 ({ve[0]:.1%})"); ax.set_ylabel(f"PC2 ({ve[1]:.1%})")
ax.set_title("PCA, top 500 variable genes\ncolor=group (orange treated, blue control), shape=batch")
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig("figures/pca.png", dpi=300); fig.savefig("figures/pca.pdf"); plt.close()
pd.DataFrame(pcs[:, :2], index=samples, columns=["PC1", "PC2"]).join(meta).to_csv("output/pca_coords.csv")

# DE: batch is balanced across groups, so adjust for it
dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts, metadata=meta, design="~batch + condition_placeholder".replace("condition_placeholder", "group"),
                   ref_level=["group", "control"], quiet=True)
dds.deseq2()
st = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=["group", "treated", "control"], alpha=0.05, quiet=True)
st.summary()
res = st.results_df.copy()
res.insert(0, "symbol", ann.loc[res.index, "symbol"])
res = res.reset_index().rename(columns={"gene_id": "gene", "log2FoldChange": "log2_fold_change",
        "padj": "adjusted_pvalue", "baseMean": "base_mean", "lfcSE": "lfc_se", "stat": "wald_stat"})

    .to_csv("output/de_treated_vs_control.csv", index=False)

a = ad.AnnData(X=counts.values.astype(float), obs=meta.loc[samples], var=ann.loc[counts.columns])
a.layers["counts"] = counts.values
a.layers["vst"] = None if False else np.log2(dds.obsm["size_factors"][:, None] ** -1 * counts.values + 1)
a.write_h5ad("output/counts_filtered.h5ad")
pd.DataFrame(a.layers["vst"], index=samples, columns=counts.columns).T.to_csv("output/normalized_log2_counts.csv")

# volcano
r = res.dropna(subset=["adjusted_pvalue"]).copy()
r["nl"] = -np.log10(r.adjusted_pvalue.clip(lower=1e-300))
sig = (r.adjusted_pvalue < 0.05) & (r.log2_fold_change.abs() > 1)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5))
ax.scatter(r.log2_fold_change[~sig], r.nl[~sig], s=8, c="grey", alpha=.6, label="not significant")
up = sig & (r.log2_fold_change > 0)
ax.scatter(r.log2_fold_change[up], r.nl[up], s=10, c="#E69F00", label=f"up (n={up.sum()})")
dn = sig & (r.log2_fold_change < 0)
ax.scatter(r.log2_fold_change[dn], r.nl[dn], s=10, c="#0072B2", label=f"down (n={dn.sum()})")
ax.axhline(-np.log10(.05), ls="--", c="k", lw=.7); ax.axvline(1, ls="--", c="k", lw=.7); ax.axvline(-1, ls="--", c="k", lw=.7)
for _, g in r[sig].nlargest(10, "nl").iterrows():
    ax.annotate(g.symbol, (g.log2_fold_change, g.nl), fontsize=7, xytext=(3, 3), textcoords="offset points")
ax.set_xlabel("log2 fold change (treated vs control)"); ax.set_ylabel("-log10 adjusted p-value")
ax.set_title("Volcano: treated vs control (PyDESeq2)\npadj<0.05, |log2FC|>1"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig("figures/volcano.png", dpi=300); fig.savefig("figures/volcano.pdf"); plt.close()

print("padj<0.05:", (r.adjusted_pvalue < .05).sum(), " and |lfc|>1:", sig.sum(), " up", up.sum(), " down", dn.sum())
print(res.head(10).to_string())
